author: CreeperJoe62
body:
I know that we've just had avicore and its brought in amazing new mini games but I think avicore is missing something. So I thought that avicus could have a factions server. It could be a seperate server or it could be part of the main avicus network or it could be its own little server.
 
Here are some of the pros of having factions.
1. Bringing in more players. I have played on many factions servers and most of them have a lot of players.

2. More money. I hope I don't make avicus sound like there money grabbing selfish people by saying this but it would bring in a lot of money.

Cons: 1. Not very original
            2.May bring in a lot of hackers

Leave your feedback below

replies.author: _Gill
replies.body: Separate donations would not work at all if it was under Avicus' name. We prefer to stay as one network. If we added it, it could potentially cause a rise in players. I am all for the idea of adding it, but not creating a separate donation system.
